text:
Zara: hey team! excited to join. i'm trying to finish Okta SSO on my iPad but keep getting 'platform authenticator not available' when registering a passkey. 1Password invite also didn't show up at my redwood email. who's the right person to ping?

Ken (IT): welcome Zara :wave: quick questions: are you on cellular or office wifi? which browser (Safari/Chrome)? does the iPad have the latest iOS?

Zara: iPadOS 17.2, using Safari on home wifi. the passkey prompt shows Touch ID, then errors with "unable to store credential". 1Password invite never arrived to zara@redwood.dev (checked spam).

onboard-bot: Ticket ONB-7822 opened for okta-passkey-ipad + 1p-misroute. Assigned to Ken (IT). ETA 60m.

Ken (IT): thanks. i'm going to re-provision your Okta factors and resend the 1Password seat. try this in an in-private tab after I push changes. Also, are you using any DNS filtering or custom VPN profile on the iPad?

Zara: no VPN or filtering, stock home ISP.

Ken (IT): re-provisioned Okta factors and resent 1Password invite to your corporate email. try in a Private tab and if it still fails, please screenshot the Safari console (Settings > Safari > Advanced > Web Inspector via a Mac).

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to zara@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Zara: got the 1Password invite and accepted it, yay. did a Private tab sign-in, passkey still errors after biometric approval with "DOMException: The operation is insecure" in the console.

Omar (Security): that console error usually indicates a SameSite/cookie issue or an intermediary altering headers. Ken, any recent proxy changes? Zara, can you try toggling "Prevent Cross-Site Tracking" off in Settings > Safari and retry?

Ken (IT): we rolled out a tiny edge-proxy tweak yesterday which might affect SameSite cookies for legacy clients. i'll check logs for your IP. Omar, assigning infra follow-up if needed.

Zara: toggled the setting, retried, and now passkey registration completes successfully. Okta accepted it and I'm in. Drive access looks good.

Ken (IT): good news. I'll add an onboarding note: if iPad passkey registration fails, try Private tab and disable Prevent Cross-Site Tracking as a short-term workaround. Also updated the ONB ticket to mark resolved.

Mina (People Ops): welcome Zara! added you to the welcome lunch and the new-hire checklist. If you didn't get the welcome packet in 1Password, ping me.

Zara: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. will set up a recovery key and let you know if anything else pops up. :smile:
